title: Private PH History tour with former Submariner/ Historian
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Step beyond the typical sightseeing experience and immerse yourself in the history of Pearl Harbor. You'll explore its most significant museums and historic landmarks while discovering the events of December 7, 1941, through engaging stories, historical context, and firsthand accounts that bring World War II to life.

Your experience includes exclusive access to Ford Island, allowing you to bypass the public shuttle and travel comfortably in a private vehicle for a more seamless and enjoyable visit. As you explore each site, you'll gain a deeper understanding of the people, events, and lasting impact of the attack on Pearl Harbor and how it shaped world history.

Throughout your tour, you'll benefit from the insights of a veteran and historian with lifelong ties to Pearl Harbor, giving you a unique perspective that transforms your visit into a meaningful and unforgettable experience.
